reply: I am CS-BOT ⚡, the official AI assistant of IEEE ENIS Computer Society Student Branch Chapter!
Joining IEEE ENIS CS SBC gives you real-world tech project experience, bootcamps (AI, Web, Cyber, Cloud), global networking, and competitive edge for your future engineering career!
CSTAM (Computer Society Tunisia Annual Meeting) is the premier flagship congress uniting tech students, researchers, and tech leaders across Tunisia.
ZeroTrace is our flagship cybersecurity CTF competition, featuring challenges in cryptography, reverse engineering, web exploitation, and network security.
We organize Welcome Days, ZeroTrace CTF, CSTAM, hands-on workshops in AI and Web, TCPC coding challenges, and IEEEXtreme training!
